newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends down on late hedges, commercials.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends down on late hedges, commercials.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended down on hedge and commercial selling, traders said.

"There were moderate hedges at the close, UGG was a seller," a trader said. Nov-Mar spread at $3.50, Jan-Mar at $0.30 and May-July $0.50. Volume was light at 2,598 lots, or 51,960 tonnes, with 400 hedge lots, traders said.
November canola closed $0.60 lower at $440, January lost $0.60 to $443.60 and March slipped $0.90 to $443.30.
October flax rose $0.50 to $398.60, November up $1.70 to $374.70 on commercials. Oct-Nov spread at $24, Oct-Jan $21. Volume was 405 lots with 70 hedge lots.
Commission houses sold 15 October oats up US$5 at US$127 to UGG, and 10 December up US$2.30 to US$218 to commercials.
October feed wheat rose $2 at $201.80 with Louis Dreyfus buying, December up $0.60 to $186.60, traders said. Oct-Dec spread at $12. Volume was 1,135 lots.

November western barley rose $0.10 to $150.30 on commercials. Nov-Feb spread at $4.50. October feedpeas lost US$1.50 to US$208, December down US$1 to US$210 with UGG and commission houses selling to PCTS. Volume was 65 lots.
(All values in Canadian dollars except oats, peas)
